Epilogue: Money Talks

paragraphs.source_en: “Money talks!” This phrase, as far back as Euripides, has eloquently expressed the power of money to get things done—in business, politics, commerce, and even romance. Unfortunately, once money talks, the conversation usually ends. Money “closes the deal,” conversationally speaking, and we shut up. We live in a money-soaked culture, yet talking about our personal finances is often taboo. It’s time to do something about that.
